1.sahih_international: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
1.pickthall: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.
1.yusuf_ali: In the name of Allah, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
1.shakir: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.
1.muhammad_sarwar: In the Name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful
1.mohsin_khan: In the Name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful.
1.arberry: In the Name of God, the Merciful, the Compassionate

2.sahih_international: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, Lord of the worlds -
2.pickthall: Praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds,
2.yusuf_ali: Praise be to Allah, the Cherisher and Sustainer of the worlds;
2.shakir: All praise is due to Allah, the Lord of the Worlds.
2.muhammad_sarwar: All praise belongs to God, Lord of the Universe,
2.mohsin_khan: All the praises and thanks be to Allah, the Lord of the 'Alamin (mankind, jinns and all that exists).
2.arberry: Praise belongs to God, the Lord of all Being,

3.sahih_international: The Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful,
3.mohsin_khan: The Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful.

4.sahih_international: Sovereign of the Day of Recompense.
4.pickthall: Master of the Day of Judgment,
4.yusuf_ali: Master of the Day of Judgment.
4.shakir: Master of the Day of Judgment.
4.muhammad_sarwar: and Master of the Day of Judgment
4.mohsin_khan: The Only Owner (and the Only Ruling Judge) of the Day of Recompense (i.e. the Day of Resurrection)
4.arberry: the Master of the Day of Doom.

5.sahih_international: It is You we worship and You we ask for help.
5.pickthall: Thee (alone) we worship; Thee (alone) we ask for help.
5.yusuf_ali: Thee do we worship, and Thine aid we seek.
5.shakir: Thee do we serve and Thee do we beseech for help.
5.muhammad_sarwar: (Lord), You alone We do worship and from You alone we do seek assistance
5.mohsin_khan: You (Alone) we worship, and you (Alone) we ask for help (for each and everything).
5.arberry: Thee only we serve; to Thee alone we pray for succour.

6.sahih_international: Guide us to the straight path -
6.shakir: Keep us on the right path.
6.muhammad_sarwar: (Lord), guide us to the right path,
6.mohsin_khan: Guide us to the Straight Way
6.arberry: Guide us in the straight path,

7.sahih_international: The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have evoked [Your] anger or of those who are astray.
7.pickthall: The path of those whom Thou hast favoured; Not the (path) of those who earn Thine anger nor of those who go astray.
7.yusuf_ali: The way of those on whom Thou hast bestowed Thy Grace, those whose (portion) is not wrath, and who go not astray.
7.shakir: The path of those upon whom Thou hast bestowed favors. Not (the path) of those upon whom Thy wrath is brought down, nor of those who go astray.
7.muhammad_sarwar: the path of those to whom You have granted blessings, those who are neither subject to Your anger nor have gone astray.
7.mohsin_khan: The Way of those on whom You have bestowed Your Grace, not (the way) of those who earned Your Anger, nor of those who went astray.
7.arberry: the path of those whom Thou hast blessed, not of those against whom Thou art wrathful, nor of those who are astray.
